catalysts.headline: Enova announces private offering of $600 million of senior notes due 2031 (subject to market conditions); proceeds intended to redeem all outstanding 11.25% senior notes due 2028 on Dec. 15, 2026, with any remainder applied to revolving credit facility, conditioned on the offering closing

Q3 2026 results: originations $2.6B (+31% YoY); total revenue crossed $1B for the first time (+26% YoY); GAAP diluted EPS $4.06 (+34%); adjusted EPS $4.48 (+33% vs. $3.36 a year earlier); repurchased $46M of stock in the quarter with $252M of buyback capacity remaining entering Q4

Supplemental detail on Q3 2026 print: total company originations $2.6B in the quarter; combined loans and finance receivables reached a record $5.9B (+30% YoY); revenue topped $1 billion in a quarter for the first time in company history (+26% YoY); consolidated net charge-off ratio improved to 8.1% from 8.5% YoY
catalysts.impact: Reinforces the earnings beat already on file

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: diluted EPS $4.06 (+34% YoY), adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS $4.48 (+33% YoY), total revenue +26% YoY, originations +31% YoY, consolidated net charge-off ratio improved to 8.1% from 8.5%; repurchased $46 million of stock during the quarter
catalysts.note: A separate third-party aggregator figure of adjusted EPS $4.37 (vs $4.34 est., revenue $1.004B) appeared in search results but does not match the company's own 8-K figures ($4.48 adjusted EPS) -- the 8-K/press-release figures are treated as authoritative; see conflicts.

catalysts.headline: Withdrew bank regulatory applications (OCC and Federal Reserve) to acquire Grasshopper Bancorp, ending the planned bank-charter acquisition; CEO Steve Cunningham cited the absence of clear regulatory standards for nonbanks seeking bank charters and said the process is susceptible to political pressure and outside advocacy; company maintained its application met statutory approval criteria; reaffirmed Q3 and full-year 2026 guidance in the same disclosure. Shares fell sharply same day (one source cites -23.43%).
catalysts.impact: Stock reportedly fell more than 20% intraday (one source: -23.43%)
catalysts.note: Deal had merger agreement with a reported $5M termination fee payable by Enova in certain circumstances; only the regulatory applications were withdrawn, not a formal termination announced in sources found. A plaintiff-side law firm (Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz) separately announced an investigation into Enova for possible securities-law violations following the stock drop -- this is a solicitation of potential claimants, not a regulatory or judicial finding.

catalysts.headline: Withdrew its OCC and Federal Reserve regulatory applications for its proposed ~$369M acquisition of Grasshopper Bancorp/Bank, effectively ending the deal; reaffirmed FY2026 guidance and said it would accelerate share buybacks
Citizens JMP cut its price target to $215 from $270
Entry into a securitization agreement: $300,886,000 aggregate principal of ENVA 2026-A notes across 3 classes, non-recourse to Enova
Q2 2026 results: adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS $4.31, beating the $3.92 consensus estimate cited by Benzinga

conflicts: Q3 2026 consumer originations: one source (statementdog) cites a record $807M (+37%); another (Webull/Motley Fool transcript) cites $870M.
Q3 2026 combined portfolio size: one source (Finviz PR copy) gives $5.9B in combined loans and finance receivables; another (Panabee) gives $6.6B at fair value.

Grasshopper Bancorp acquisition status: one source (StockAnalysis transcript reference) describes the deal as pending, expected to close in H2 2026; another (Panabee) refers to its termination. Status could not be reconciled in this pass.
notes: The Nov. 4, 2026 $600M notes offering is new information since the Oct. 22 Q3 print already on file and should break the quiet streak. Recommend confirming in a follow-up pass whether the notes offering priced/closed, and resolving the Grasshopper Bancorp deal-status conflict directly via Enova IR or an 8-K search (sec.gov was unreachable via WebFetch in this sandbox; the SEC exhibit URL above was surfaced via WebSearch only).
